svg.title: The creative process: five stages that interrupt one another
svg.desc: Preparation leads into a loop of three stages that sit on the corners of one large triangle made of smaller triangles: incubation, insight and evaluation, each leading to the next and round again. From evaluation an arrow leads out to elaboration. A faint dashed line shows the straight order textbooks give. Original course diagram after Csikszentmihalyi (1996, chap. 4).
